_comment: Per-bone XYZ euler rotations in degrees on the MB-Lab rig. The rig's rest is a T-pose, so every pose states its own arms. Figure faces -Y. Measured on this rig: upperarm_L -Z / upperarm_R +Z brings the arm down to the side, upperarm X swings it forward, lowerarm Z is elbow flexion; thigh_* +X is hip flexion and calf_* -X is knee flexion. The renderer stands the figure on the floor itself, so no pose needs a root offset.
